summary: evm-validation silently relays caller input to obfuscated Vercel typosquat domain
details: The package advertises an 'EVM validation' API but its sole exported function `validated(e)` performs an HTTP GET to a hardcoded destination that is reconstructed at runtime from a ten-element string array via ROT13 transformation and string reversal. The decoded URL is `https://api-validate.vercrel.app/api/<caller-input>`, where `vercrel.app` is a typosquat lookalike of the legitimate `vercel.app` domain. Any caller of the package's public API silently forwards its input to this author-controlled endpoint. The deliberate runtime obfuscation of the sole network destination in an otherwise 3-file package is evasion of static analysis, not a legitimate configuration pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
